summary: Draft updated at submission.json (validated read-only: valid, no diagnostics). With the run's remaining budget short, this final step is a source trace rather than a new execution: it registers question @lease_read_preconditions (child of the first ReadIndex question) with a sourced Behaviour entry covering the lease-based read option's preconditions and deviations - Config.validate refuses ReadOnlyLeaseBased without CheckQuorum (raft.go:334-335, documented at 236-241); the lease branch of sendMsgReadIndexResponse answers immediately with the leader's committed index, registering nothing in readOnly and broadcasting no heartbeat (raft.go:2142-2157); a lease-based follower ignores MsgForgetLeader (raft.go:1745-1746); and independently of the option, stepLeader still defers read requests until the leader has committed in its term (raft.go:1346-1363). The registered discriminator for a later run is: construct a RawNode with the option enabled and CheckQuorum disabled and record the configuration error; then compare a lease-based local read (expected: answer with no heartbeat) against the same call under ReadOnlySafe (expected: heartbeat plus acknowledgements); and step MsgForgetLeader into a lease-based follower to confirm it is ignored. Limitations state plainly that this is a source trace with no execution yet, that the lease's clock-drift assumption lies outside the captured package, and that it does not revisit the earlier ReadIndex findings. Across the run the record now holds nine answered questions with retained receipts - the rctx-coalescing liveness and stale-index results, the empty-payload and undecodable-payload abort family on the read and proposal paths, the silent conf-change replacement and the last-voter apply abort, the removed-leader stall with its step-down control, external-trigger boundary and varied-schedule reproduction, and the Node API's deadline-only signal - plus two source-explained negative results (the deferred read being released, and the validated response shape); defect validity, CFT relevance and deduplication remain with human review.
